case.why_this_one: It is the case whose expectations are reachable from a decoder alone. The switch-* cases additionally need SwiGLU and routing, which Slice 1 does not implement, and the predicate case is a naming rule this crate deliberately does not implement.

statement: R1 and R3 qualified against the frozen Flash research fixture that the governing design note names for this slice. Round 1 never consumed it: running the existing Python research tests establishes things about the Python path, not about this Rust decoder. The fixture is read only; nothing in this work writes to fixtures/research/.
what_this_does_not_establish: no quantized matmul or gather_qmm claim: the matmuls are done in the test, in binary64, from R1's dequantized weights
no claim about the Python research path, which is qualified separately and by its own tests
no real-checkpoint claim of any kind
